cs.t: Wyze refused to reconnect to my new WiFi access points with the same SSID but a different password. All kinds of resets did nothing and I ate the costs and switched my smart plugs to Kasa from TP Link. It’s been better but not without faults. Philips hue has very rarely caused me troubles except the adhesive on their cabinet lights was garbage.
